ops.body: A3 (b134be1a) committed + sol-reviewed; A4+A8 implementing. A3.1 fix round QUEUED and BLOCKS the next release — five accepted findings from the A3 review: (1) SPEND LEAK: infra-retry attempt costs neither journaled nor budget-counted (repro: two $0.60 proposals complete under a $0.70 cap) — per-attempt costs go into the sidecar events and every budget summation (loop max_usd; later the A6b campaign ledger) must sum journal + sidecar; (2) staged retry: re-SCORE an already-committed candidate instead of re-proposing (retries currently swap in a different candidate under the same unit index, contradicting the deterministic-re-score docstring, and discard paid proposals); (3) origin-aware git classification: candidate-tree staging failures (e.g. FIFO in a mutable path -> git add exits 128) must journal candidate CRASH, not burn infra retries and abort; CalledProcessError->infra only for harness-side git; (4) sidecar torn-write recovery (writer line-start guarantee; a torn line currently undercounts then poisons the reader); (5) measure() returns the metric-absence reason directly (TOCTOU re-stat window). Refuted by the same review: double-journaling, worktree leaks, marker-vs-valid-metric ordering, cross-experiment bleed, resume double-count.
